name: buck_lmr36006
title: 3.3 V regulator
purpose: 28 V to 3.3 V buck for the logic (LMR36006-Q1, 400 kHz adjustable)

sources.title: TI LMR36006-Q1 4.2 to 60 V 0.6 A synchronous buck (SNVSAY7D)
sources.licence: TI datasheet; link and quotes only
sources.read: p1, p3 options, p4 pins, p5-7 ratings, p19-24 application and component selection, p34 TVS note, p46-47 RNX0012B

parts.quote: "4.2-V to 60-V, 0.6-A Ultra-Small Synchronous Step-Down Converter"; "LMR36006AQRNXRQ1 Adjustable ... 400 kHz"; "VIN to PGND 4.2 ... 60 V"; pins Table 6-1. 400 kHz, not the 2.1 MHz fixed 3.3 V part: at 28 V in, 3.3 V out at 2.1 MHz needs about 56 ns on-time, at its "tON-MIN Minimum switch on-time 55 ... 83 ns"
"A minimum ceramic capacitance of 4.7 µF is required on the input"; "rated for at least the maximum input voltage ... preferably twice"; "4.7-µF, 100-V, X7R"
"a small case size 220-nF ceramic capacitor must be used at the input as close a possible to the regulator" (Fig. 9-1: CHF1, CHF2)
Fig. 9-1 CHF2, the second high-frequency input capacitor, on the other VIN pin (10)
"Connect a high-quality 100-nF capacitor from this pin to the SW pin"; "A high-quality ceramic capacitor of 100 nF and at least 16 V is required"
"Connect a high-quality 1-µF capacitor from this pin to GND" (VCC)

Table 9-3 "3.3 V 400 kHz ... 2 × 22 µF 22 µH, 250 mΩ LMR36006AQRNXRQ1"; "the inductor saturation current must not be less than the device low-side current limit" and ideally at least "ISC" ("High-side current limit 0.8 1 1.2 A"). The part number (Coilcraft XFL4020-223, the 4 x 4 mm body used on star-tracker-n6) is unverified: its 22 µH row was not read
Table 9-3 COUT "2 × 22 µF" for 3.3 V at 400 kHz
"The recommended value for RFBT is 100 kΩ"
Table 9-1 "400 3.3 22 2 × 22µF 1 × 22µF 100 k 43.2 k 20 pF" (RFBT, RFBB, CFF); RFBB = RFBT / (VOUT/VREF - 1), "VREF is nominally 1 V"

layout.rules: p25-style layout: input capacitors at the VIN pins, short SW loop to L1, feedback divider away from SW

open_questions: EN tied to VIN ("Can be connected directly to VIN"): the regulator runs whenever 28 V is present. PG unused ("Can be open or grounded when not used").
Table 9-3 gives RFBB 43.3 kΩ for the same design; Table 9-1 and the formula's nearest E96 value give 43.2 kΩ.
L1's part number is not verified against Coilcraft's datasheet.
